scope: Changed optional-learning privacy wording, navigation labels and sitemap inclusion; existing hosting, backup, provider and owner-auth deployment claims were not re-audited.

checks.subject: Optional storage
checks.result: Aligned: learning and planning begin with remembering disabled, preserve their separate opt-ins/keys, and remove their own saved record on reset. Learning answers stay in component state; the persistent schema holds public item/path identifiers, statuses, bookmarks and completed challenge versions. No learning-progress network submission is implemented.

checks.subject: Controls and meaning
checks.result: Aligned: privacy and both learning interfaces explain local-profile visibility, independent plan/learning reset and activity-only points. Reading, practice and public guides are not gated by sign-in or a legal-readiness score.

checks.subject: Navigation and sitemap
checks.result: Aligned: Learn, Library and Tools point to their actual routes; Network opens the plainly titled interest form. Footer preserves privacy/contact/methodology/coverage access. Sitemap adds /learn/, includes published guides/tools and public hubs, excludes owner/API/plan and unpublished guides, and does not invent a content-review date for the new learning route.

findings.issue: The literal storage key eln-learning-v1 is accurate but is an implementation detail in otherwise owner-facing copy.
findings.recommendation: Optionally replace “the separate browser storage key eln-learning-v1 holds” with “a separate record in this browser holds”. The developer identifier is unnecessary for understanding the opt-in or reset choice.
findings.resolution: The literal storage key has been removed from the privacy copy; optional local storage, record contents and reset choice remain accurately explained.
